title: Department of Commerce Announces Definitive Agreement with I-Pulse for a $250 Million CHIPS R&D Award to Develop Novel Silicon-Carbide Semiconductors
summary: The Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Research & Development Office today announced the signing of a definitive agreement with I-Pulse for a $250 million award under the CHIPS and Science Act.
author: Andrew Kim
title_norm: department of commerce announces definitive agreement with i pulse for a 250 million chips r d award to develop novel silicon carbide semiconductors
